items.title: Pete Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: And meeting Dokshizer, he called us in Rotterdam the opening night after two weeks they have in Alba. We talked under Dorwin Handy, the interpreter

ctx.x: Nowadays people pay for it themselves.

Yeah. Either that or a special deal of some kind or something. And you know now we did, with the Metropole Orchestra, we opened up the Trumpet Guild, I think it was the fifth Trumpet Guild or Brass Trumpet Guild they call it, in Holland. And in there they had trumpet players from South America, Maurice Andre of France that performed with the Philharmonic, and I got to meet Timofei Dokshizer, the great Russian trumpet player. And it was Chuck Findley and Bob Findley, brothers, and Conte and I, we went over there…
Wow. Well this has been really quite fascinating.
